name: A Reef in a Square Basin

levels.entry: A basin, brick-lined, perhaps two hundred feet on a side. Far too regular to be anything but built.
Lothal's dockyard, which the chronicles describe and which nobody has seen dry in living memory.
The sluice is silted shut. It has been a closed pool since the Shattering, and everything in it has been in it that whole time.

notes: Archaeology that unlocks two other chains. Being a closed system is what makes it evidence for both the salt and the lurker.
